column1: # EdgeHax Launcher -- shared partition table for the dual-boot setup
#   factory = this launcher (boots on every reset/power-up)
#   ota_0   = SecureVault (password manager)  <- firmware.bin from that project
#   ota_1   = ShadowTune  (MP3 player)        <- firmware.bin from that project
# nvs / phy_init / gpio_cfg / littlefs keep the same names
# types the two apps already look for at runtime (they find partitions by
# nvs is kept at the same offset/size both apps used before (0x9000
# so SecureVault's PIN and both apps' NVS settings survive the move.
# Subtype is written numerically (0x83 / 0x40) for the same reason as in the
# original projects: raw ESP-IDF gen_esp32part.py does not know "littlefs".
